name: wilderness-times
description: Wilderness Times packing checklists, 350+ rated tents and gear buying guides.

interface.longDescription:
Wilderness Times turns ChatGPT into a trip-prep helper backed by our own outdoor guides.

Get a complete packing checklist for 12 activities: camping, backpacking, hiking, winter and beach camping, kayak and motorcycle camping, camping with toddlers and more. Tailor it to your trip, then open it as a link you can check off on your phone, or grab the printable PDF.

Ask which tent to buy and get picks from 350+ tents we have scored out of 10, filtered by how many people they really sleep, seasons and weight, each with a typical price range. For sleeping bags, stoves, chairs and other gear, it points you to our buying guides.

No account needed.
defaultPrompt: What should I pack for a weekend camping trip?
What's the best tent for a family of 4?
Make me a winter camping checklist I can check off on my phone.

positive.description: Get a standard packing checklist for an activity.
positive.prompt: What should I pack for a weekend camping trip?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the Wilderness Times camping checklist grouped by category (the assistant may condense it for a weekend), with a link to the full interactive checklist that ticks off and exports to PDF or a spreadsheet.

positive.description: Tailor a checklist and hand it back as a usable link.
positive.prompt: Make me an overnight backpacking list, but skip the binoculars and two-way radios, add bear spray, and give me a link I can check off on my phone.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the 72-item backpacking checklist with binoculars and two-way radios removed and bear spray added (71 items), plus a link that opens the tailored list in the Wilderness Times checklist builder.

positive.description: Recommend tents filtered by group size.
positive.prompt: What's the best tent for a family of 4?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns tents that realistically sleep 4 to 6, ranked by Wilderness Times score (top picks around 8.2 to 8.6 out of 10), each with a typical price range and a link to its review.

positive.description: Show full detail on one recommended tent, with alternatives.
positive.prompt: Tell me more about the CORE 9 Person Instant Cabin Tent and what else is similar.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns that tent's Wilderness Times score, realistic capacity, specs, pros and cons and review link, plus other sizes of the same model and similar tents from other brands at the same realistic capacity.

positive.prompt: Can I get a printable winter camping checklist?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a link to the printable Wilderness Times Winter Camping Checklist PDF.

negative.description: Do not trigger for campsite reservations, which the app cannot make.
negative.prompt: Book me a campsite at Yosemite for next weekend.
negative.expected_behavior: The app should not be invoked; it has no booking or reservation capability.

negative.description: Do not trigger for weather or trail-condition questions.
negative.prompt: What's the weather going to be at Zion this Saturday?
negative.expected_behavior: The app should not be invoked; it holds no weather or live conditions data.

negative.description: Do not trigger for purchases or price checks.
negative.prompt: Buy me the cheapest 4-person tent on Amazon right now.
negative.expected_behavior: The app should not be invoked to purchase or quote a live price; it cannot buy items, and it carries only typical price ranges, not current prices.

review.commerce_description: Wilderness Times does not sell anything or take payments in ChatGPT. Gear results name retailers, may show a typical price range (an editorial estimate, never a live price or offer) and link to our reviews; there are no carts or checkout.

publication.release_notes: Packing checklists for 12 activities, a shareable check-off link and printable PDFs, plus tent picks from 350+ scored tents with typical price ranges, and gear buying guides.
